title: pz-godot community model entry
description: One sprite's current model and every version it has ever had. Written only by the Discord bot; history is append-only.

sprite_id.description: The PZ sprite this model replaces. Must exist in catalog/sprites.json.

sheet.description: sprite_id minus its trailing _N, matching MeshOverrides.sheet_of().

history.description: Superseded versions, newest first. Append-only: a revert re-publishes an old blob as a new version rather than rewriting this.

version.description: Monotonic per sprite. Never reused, even after a revert.

blob_sha.description: Git blob SHA-1 of this version's .glb. This is the durable pointer: blobs reachable from history are never garbage-collected, so any past version stays fetchable via the git blobs API long after models/<sprite_id>.glb has moved on.

commit_sha.description: The commit that introduced this version. Null for the current version, which cannot know its own commit's SHA at the time it is written; filled in when the version is superseded.

sha256.description: Content hash of the .glb. What the installer verifies against before writing a downloaded file to disk.

license.description: Chosen by the author at submission. Covers the model only, never the PZ art it is textured from at runtime.

texture_bindings.description: Sprite ids this model's pz: materials name. Derived from the .glb at validation time, never author-declared, so it cannot disagree with the file.

embedded_textures.description: Almost always false. True only where an admin signed off on an author's own original texture; see textures_approved_by.

textures_approved_by.description: Discord id of the admin who admitted an embedded texture, and null otherwise.

override.description: The by_type calibration written into the player's data/mesh_overrides.json. Rotation is Y degrees and is ADDITIVE to each instance's own PZ yaw.

replaced_by_vote.description: Present on a version that lost a head-to-head community vote.
